facts.fact: The Namibian Standards Institution (NSI) notice of 2026-06-15 states that four standards (chilled seafood, dates, laundry process management, refrigerating-appliance energy performance) were officially developed as NAMS, Namibian Standards, and are on sale through the NSI; the notice does not mention a law or decree setting up the body.

note: All four adopted NAMS are non-IT (food, laundry, appliance energy), so no published fact; no certifier or certification against an IT or data standard is named.
